role: An add-on that hosts Dash apps against the local database. Your AI agent drives it through its MCP control plane while you watch the result in a browser.
url: http://127.0.0.1:5100 by default. If something else already holds that port the install moves to the next free one and records it - so to see where yours is actually serving, run dash-server: it prints the address, and if a copy is already up it says so and prints that one's address rather than starting a second.
control_plane: The same address with /mcp on the end. exakit mcp-setup registers it as an MCP server named dash-server, so its tools sit beside the exasol ones once the client restarts - Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and Continue. Claude Desktop is the one left out: its config file has no shape for a remote MCP server (the app takes those through its own Connectors settings), so setup prints one note naming the URL and the run is not affected.
installed_by: exakit marketplace dash-server, or the install itself (it is installed automatically).
warning: The control plane at /mcp is unauthenticated and bound to 127.0.0.1. Anything that can reach loopback on this machine - any other session on a shared box, any script, any browser page - can build, deploy and pip-install dependencies for Dash apps as you. That is fine on a personal laptop; on a shared or multi-user machine, stop dash-server when you are not using it (exakit stop dash-server leaves the database running). Never put this port on a LAN or behind a public tunnel.
db_user: Reuses the kit's read-only mcp_readonly user - dashboards read, they do not write. Without that user (exakit mcp-setup makes it) Dash Server starts with no database connection; it is never given the administrator's password.

quickstart.note: Space selects dash-server, Enter installs it. That is the whole install.
It prints the address it is serving on. Run it again any time you need that address - an already-running copy reports itself instead of starting a second one.
Ask your AI agent. It drives the control plane while you watch the page in a browser.

commands.summary: Update it to the advertised version. A running server is stopped and started again on it.
commands.description: A stopped server stays stopped. At the same version nothing changes, so to restart the current server run exakit stop dash-server, then exakit start dash-server. With EXAKIT_DASH_SERVER_PORT set to a new port, the server moves there, even at the same version, and the AI clients are pointed at it.

parameters.name: <component>...
parameters.description: Update only these kit-owned components or add-ons, each once and in any order. A uv or pyexasol the kit did not install is updated through its own tool, and other user-owned components are kept. An add-on that is not installed is not updated: install it with exakit marketplace <id>.

parameters.name: --yes, -y
parameters.description: Allow a pending runtime update that stops and restarts the database; not permission to remove user-owned resources.
parameters.default: ask on a terminal; defer runtime changes without a terminal

environment.name: EXAKIT_DASH_SERVER_PORT
environment.effect: The loopback port to serve on. Default 5100, and a free one is recorded instead when that is taken at install time. To move an installed server, set it for one update: EXAKIT_DASH_SERVER_PORT=5200 exakit update dash-server. A running server is stopped on its old port and started on the new one, and the AI clients are pointed at it.

environment.name: EXAKIT_DASH_SERVER_VERSION
environment.effect: Override the advertised package version for install/update. Existing user-owned copies stay unmanaged.

notes: Not sure which port yours is on? Run dash-server. It prints the address, whether it starts one or finds one already running.
If port 5100 is taken at install time the kit moves to the next free port and records it.
The launcher stores only the PATH of the credential file, never the password, and reads it fresh at run time.

Supply chain: dash-server is the one add-on the kit installs WITHOUT a pinned checksum. The version is tag-pinned, but the install is uv pip install of the tag's GitHub source tarball - and source tarballs publish no digest, so there is nothing kit-side to verify the download against; its Python dependencies then come from PyPI unpinned. The other add-ons refuse an artifact whose digest they cannot check. Install this one only if you trust exasol-labs/dash-server and the network you are on.

troubleshooting.symptom: It looks like a crash on start
troubleshooting.remedy: A second copy cannot bind the port. The first one is already serving - check exakit status.

troubleshooting.symptom: The control plane answers but the page is blank or 500
troubleshooting.remedy: exakit logs dash-server -f while you reload the page.

troubleshooting.symptom: After an update the MCP tools or pages still behave like the old version
troubleshooting.remedy: Restart just this server: exakit stop dash-server, then exakit start dash-server. Then reload your AI client so it lists the tools again.
